train_selection: first 32 rows in frozen training order, disjoint blocks of four
fresh_rollouts: generated from current adapter at every iteration
zero_signal_rule: skip optimizer step entirely when all RL signals are zero
normalization: per-response token mean, then equal mean of all 16 responses
truncation_rule: retain all generated completion tokens; include EOS when present; flag truncation; frozen reward v3

evaluation.baseline: same frozen initial adapter, evaluated once

timing: synchronized generation, old-student scoring, teacher scoring and backward/update; audits/checkpoints/setup/eval separate
planned_resume_check: RL deliberately pauses at the first completed boundary, then resumes the same 8-iteration run
